ppi_edge_any.description: 1 if any screen has a direct edge

ppi_n_studies.description: number of independent studies (BioPlex(either line), HuRI, OpenCell, Buljan, HCM) with a direct edge (0-5)

ppi_rwr.description: RWR (restart 0.5) visiting probability of protein from kinase seed on the combined screens graph (column-stochastic, sums to 1 over graph nodes)
ppi_rwr.missing: NaN = kinase or protein not in graph

ppi_rwr_dc.description: degree-corrected RWR: log2((rwr+eps)/(bg+eps)), bg = mean RWR of the protein over all seeds (hub correction), eps=0.01/N
ppi_rwr_dc.missing: NaN = kinase or protein not in graph

ppi_rwr_dc_pct.description: within-kinase percentile of ppi_rwr_dc over graph proteins

ppi_dist.description: shortest path length (hops) kinase->protein on combined graph, capped at 5
ppi_dist.missing: NaN = kinase or protein not in graph
